subject: Cannot connect to database after deployment

thread.body: Hi, since the deployment this morning we can no longer connect to the database. We get connection refused errors on port 5432.
Checked the security group rules. The new deployment changed the inbound rules and blocked port 5432 from the app servers.
We have identified and fixed the issue. The security group was updated during deployment to block database traffic. It has been restored. Please verify connectivity.
